title: gaps.jsonl row
description: Known codes: no_text_layer: the PDF has no text layer (flow B not implemented); lang_mismatch: the declared language differs from the detected one; decl_mismatch: another declaration field differs from what the file shows; extractor_degraded: an extractor could not be used; a fallback was taken; table_missed: a find_tables candidate no engine table matches; table_header_suspect: a header cell's text differs between the engine and the text layer; table_cross_mismatch: numbers differ between the engine table and find_tables or the text layer; table_cells_dropped: engine cells without a box were dropped; table_text_unaccounted: a number word of the text layer inside a table is not in its cells; ocr_text: reserved for flow B (OCR); image_region_unread: reserved for flow B (image regions not read). Fields not listed here may be added within v1; listed codes and fields are never renamed or removed.

code.description: gap code; the known codes are listed below. Contract v1 only adds codes and fields, it never renames or removes them

page_no.description: page the gap is on (absent for document-level gaps)

table_id.description: the table the gap is about (tables.jsonl)

ref.description: the layout engine's own id of the item (e.g. a DoclingDocument self_ref)

extractor.description: extractor_degraded: which extractor degraded (the layout engine name, find_tables, page_kinds, headings)

status.description: extractor_degraded: the layout engine's status (timeout, crashed, error, not_ready, disabled, partial_success, ...)

pages.description: extractor_degraded (document level): "all", or the pages that fell back to find_tables

table_index.description: extractor_degraded (find_tables): 1-based index of the candidate on its page

find_tables_id.description: table_missed / table_cross_mismatch: id of the find_tables candidate

resolution.description: table_missed: find_tables (candidate entered) or not_entered; table_header_suspect: text_layer (text layer won) or kept_engine

engine_region.description: table_missed: the region the layout engine has at the candidate's place

engine.description: table_header_suspect: the header text as the layout engine read it

text_layer.description: table_header_suspect: the header text re-read from the text layer

source.description: table_cross_mismatch: what the engine table was compared with

only_engine.description: table_cross_mismatch (find_tables): numbers only in the engine table (at most 20)

only_find_tables.description: table_cross_mismatch (find_tables): numbers only in the find_tables candidate (at most 20)

text.description: table_text_unaccounted: the text-layer word not found in the cells
